repos.description: The batteries-included agent harness.
repos.readme_excerpt:
The batteries-included agent harness.

Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.

• Opinionated — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work

• Extensible — override or replace any piece without forking

• Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local

• Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith

• Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows

• Filesystem — read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends

• Context management — summarize long threads and offload tool outputs to disk

• Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice

• Persistent memory — pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall

This is a detached fork of the UAD project. This aims to improve privacy and efficiency (energy, speed, memory) by removing unnecessary and obscure system apps. This can also improve security by reducing the attack surface. Read the wiki for more details.

# Documentation

Everything about UAD-ng (and related stuff) can be found on the Wiki, such as:

• Features of this app

• Suggested Android app replacements

• How to get the cutting-edge version by building the source-code

UAD-ng does not collect or transmit any user data. The only external connections are GET requests to GitHub for fetching the package list (crates/uad-core/src/uad_lists.rs) and checking for updates (crates/uad-core/src/update.rs).

# MiniWatts

An iPhone and iPad battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs. It reads the device's own power-management sensors — the ones iOS uses to run the charge — and shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what every temperature sensor in the device is doing while it happens.

> Sideload only. Private APIs mean this can never be on the App Store — you sign > and install it yourself. There is no network code of any kind: nothing it reads > leaves your phone.

Download the latest MiniWatts-unsigned.ipa from Releases and sign it with your own Apple ID — Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore and Xcode all do this. A free Apple ID works; the app then expires after seven days and you re-sign it.

Requires iPhone or iPad, iOS 17 or later.

repos.description: AI-guided editable scientific figures with Codex and local Origin/OriginPro
repos.readme_excerpt:
把表格交给 Codex，把可编辑的科研图带回 Origin 理解数据 · 选择表达 · 定制样式 · 检查交付 三步开始 · 看图选模板 · 复制提示词 · 完整教程 · English

我做 EditaPlot，是想少花一些时间反复调图，多留一些时间讨论数据本身。你把表格和想表达的问题告诉 Codex，它会先说明每列的用途，等你确认后，再调用本机 Origin 绘图和检查结果。

它是一个 Codex Skill，不是独立绘图软件。你仍然可以在 Origin 中继续编辑曲线、坐标轴和图例；配色、线宽与版式也可以在已支持的范围内按你的需求调整。

使用前提：Windows 10/11 x64 实体电脑 + Codex + 本机 Origin/OriginPro。 日常使用不需要提前打开 Origin；Mac、Linux、WSL 和虚拟机暂不支持。

# 先看看能画什么

按实际列展示背景、包络和组分，不补造缺失峰。 同时看组间分布和每个观测，而不只看一根柱子。 使用上游已提供的逐样本 SHAP；绘图层不训练模型。 保留全部 900 个源值与行列顺序，不插值、不自动聚类。

这些示例都用合成教学数据，由真实 Origin 生成，不代表实验或临床结论。点击图片可以看原图。

repos.readme_excerpt:
# Inphic 鼠标电量托盘

给英菲克（INPHIC）无线鼠标加一个任务栏电量显示。支持 IN10（设备主动上报）与 IN9（Feature Report 主动查询）两代。

不修改原厂驱动、不注入原厂软件、不写入设备——只是监听鼠标本来就每 2 秒主动发出的电量报告，然后画在托盘上。

# 为什么做这个

原厂配置工具 INPHIC HUB 只在它自己的界面里显示电量，而且必须打开软件、点进设备页才看得到。托盘不显示电量，关掉程序就什么都不知道了。

Windows 自带的"蓝牙设备电量"对 2.4G 接收器无效，所以只能自己做一个。

# 特性

# 托盘状态

# 快速开始

# 方式一：直接用

• 右键图标 → 勾选「开机自动启动」

> 建议不要放在原厂软件目录里——卸载或重装 INPHIC HUB 时可能被一起删掉，开机自启就失效了。

# 方式二：自己编译

# 使用

# 工作原理

# 传输层

原厂软件是纯用户态程序，用 hidapi 走 HID Output/Input Report，没有内核驱动。本工具直接用 Windows 的 hid.dll + setupapi.dll 枚举和读取，连 hidapi.dll 都不需要。

关键点：用 FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE 共享方式打开。HID 输入报告会复制给所有打开该接口的句柄，所以本工具可以和原厂软件同时运行，互不干扰。

# 电量报告格式（已实测）

电量走在 Usage Page 0x000A 那个接口上（注意不是 64 字节的厂商通道），固定 5 字节：

# 上报规律（已实测）

最后两条是离线检测只能靠超时的原因：设备不会告诉你它走了，只能靠"沉默 8 秒"推断。

# 为什么是 8 秒

上报周期 2 秒，8 秒 = 连续漏掉 4 帧，不会因为一次抖动误判，也不至于关机后太久才变灰。

# 连接方式怎么判断

不是问设备，是看 HID 接口路径：蓝牙设备走 BTHENUM 路径，其余判为 USB。这和厂商自己的做法一致（原厂软件靠 VID 区分不同连接模式）。

# 图标渲染

托盘图标是运行时用 GDI+ 逐像素画的，不是预先做好的图片：

• 把 MouseIcon.png 缩放到系统实际图标尺寸（通常 16×16）

# BehaviorTree.CPP 4.9

This C++ 17 library provides a framework to create BehaviorTrees. It was designed to be flexible, easy to use, reactive and fast.

Even if our main use-case is robotics, you can use this library to build AI for games, or to replace Finite State Machines.

There are a few features that make BehaviorTree.CPP unique, when compared to other implementations:

• It makes asynchronous Actions, i.e. non-blocking, a first-class citizen.

• You can build reactive behaviors that execute multiple Actions concurrently (orthogonality).

• Trees are defined using a Domain Specific scripting language (based on XML), and can be loaded at run-time; in other words, even if written in C++, the morphology of the Trees is _not_ hard-coded.

• You can statically link your custom TreeNodes or convert them into plugins

and load them at run-time.

• It provides a type-safe and flexible mechanism to do Dataflow between

Nodes of the Tree.

repos.readme_excerpt:
Lenovo Legion Linux Support

# Other language versions of this README file:

This project is not affiliated with Lenovo in any way

Lenovo Legion Linux (LLL) brings additional drivers and tools for Lenovo Legion series laptops to Linux. It is the alternative to Lenovo Vantage or Legion Zone (both Windows only).

It allows you to control features like the fan curve, power mode, power limits, rapid charging, and more. This has been achieved through reverse engineering and disassembling the ACPI firmware, as well as the firmware and memory of the embedded controller (EC).

:star: Please star this repository if this is useful or might be useful in the future.

# Halo Battery

Battery levels of your wireless mouse, keyboard, headset and controller, right in the Windows tray. One icon per device. No vendor software.

• No vendor apps. Close Synapse, G HUB, NGENUITY and the rest: Halo Battery talks to the receiver, the cable or Windows Bluetooth itself.

• 30+ brands. Razer, Logitech, SteelSeries, HyperX, Corsair, ASUS ROG, Sony, Xbox, Nintendo, 8BitDo, Pulsar, Keychron and many more.

• Stays out of the way. Alerts wait until your full-screen game closes, and devices are polled less often while you play.

• Native look. A Windows 11 style menu, sharp at any display scale, light or dark.

• Autoupdates. A new release installs from the tray menu in one click.

# Install

• Download HaloBattery- .zip from the latest release.

repos.description: Show estimate time left to full charge on your lock screen
repos.readme_excerpt:
# About

Jikan puts a charging estimate on your Lock Screen. Set the percentage you want to reach and see how much time is left. Choose a pill you can tap for more battery readings, or a compact estimate beside the date.

# Pill or date row

The Classic pill shows your remaining time with a charging indicator. Progress Ring shows the estimate alongside a circular display of your progress toward the selected target. You can preview both styles in Settings.

On iOS 16 or later, Use Date Row Instead places an estimate such as "27m to 80%" alongside the date. It also works with an existing inline widget.

# Charging estimates

Apple is the default and recommended algorithm when the device provides its required inputs. Devices without usable native inputs automatically use Jikan; you can still select Apple and accept a warning to use approximate inputs. Apple uses reconstructed charging models based on Apple's iOS 26 estimator, with targets of 80%, 85%, 90%, 95%, and 100%.
